rules.text: a regiment-shaped id whose state code is Confederate-only but whose prefix is U-, where the C- twin exists: the ONLY rule that changes a side (10 ids).
OOB ids that extend the placed id with a suffix (U-8IL -> U-8IL-CAV); unique candidate, same side.
<regiment id>-<tag> where the base regiment exists; high only when the tag matches a commander or nickname in the regiment's brigade/division chain (a single letter also needs the note to name him).
<corps>-<div>-<n><state>: the tail resolves to a regiment whose division equals the id prefix.
"<Name>'s brigade/division" in the row note resolves to the OOB record of the same kind and side whose commander (or designation) is <Name>; one-letter surname typos allowed; never across sides.
C-ART-<Name>: the battalion or artillery brigade whose commander/designation is <Name>.
the 8 U-VI-* brigades: no OOB record exists; see candidates/vi_corps_brigades.json.

hard_rules: never map a regiment-shaped id to a brigade (checked)
never change a side except by wrong_side_prefix (checked)
Regulars use UR (not implemented: no such id among the 95)
ambiguous matches stay none with the candidates listed
confidence_definition: Confidence is assessed PER PLACEMENT ROW: the rule cascade is run over the id's rows together (the id-level proposal) and once over each row alone (row_confidence[]: that row's own evidence; a row whose note names nothing, or names another formation, does not inherit support from its siblings). The id-level `confidence` is the weakest row (never "none" when a proposal exists: rows without support of their own are counted in rows_by_confidence.none, and a row that names a different target adds a WARNING). combined_notes_confidence keeps the verdict on the concatenated notes for the record. Only an id whose every row is high is status proposed_auto.
